ruleText: Fewer wilderness encounters while keeping pack size. Every placed reference rolls its regional predator leveled list independently, so thinning wolves out of the lists lowers frequency AND turns a three-point site into a wolf, a bear and a spider. Retiring whole spatial CLUSTERS instead lowers frequency and leaves pack size exactly as Bethesda placed it - and retiring the singletons first raises it, because the lone predator between packs is what makes the wilderness feel crowded. Measured on Skyrim.esm alone: 666 placed refs on these actors form 406 clusters at a 2000-unit link radius (205 singletons, 146 pairs, 51 triples, 4 quads); retiring the singletons leaves 461 refs in 201 clusters, mean pack 2.29, with no lone predator anywhere. Nothing is deleted - a deleted ACHR is a UDR - the references are flagged Initially Disabled, so rollback is disabling one plugin. Only wolf-bearing regional lists are in scope: LCharAnimalForestSnowPredator has 0 wolf entries and its 30 placed refs are therefore left alone. User design 2026-09-02 on #42; measurements in the 2026-09-02 appendix of docs/WILDLIFE-WOLVES-2026-08-28.md.
